title: Payment Arrangements Servicing Sheet — Which Pre-Suspension Installment Carries the Missed Entry
content:
For a suspended plan under Payment Arrangements, the installment that carries the missed entry owed from before the suspension is determined as follows.

## Definition

The counting cutoff is the date missed-installment counting stopped. The examined installment is the last installment whose scheduled due date falls on or before the counting cutoff: the schedule anchor installment plus the whole periods from the schedule anchor date to the counting cutoff, counted in weeks of seven days for a weekly plan, in fortnights of fourteen days for a biweekly plan and in whole calendar months for a monthly plan.

The pre-suspension grace elapsed days are the calendar days from the grace start to the counting cutoff, and the pre-suspension grace is the grace length plus the hold-timing extension plus the weekend-due extension.

The missed entry goes to the examined installment when its pre-suspension grace elapsed days are more than its pre-suspension grace or when it was never presented for collection; when they are not, its grace had not run out by the cutoff and the missed entry goes to the installment immediately before it.

The counting cutoff is the plan's suspended date, the grace starts on the examined installment's scheduled due date, the grace length is the type's grace period for the plan's funding method (the automatic-debit grace for automatic debit, the manual grace for manual payment), and the hold-timing extension and the weekend-due extension are both 0 days.

An installment never presented for collection is one with no installment payment entry on the plan's installment history; a presented installment carries its scheduled due date on its payment entries.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Schedule anchor installment, schedule anchor date, frequency, funding method, suspended date | The plan record |
| Payment entries of the examined installment | The plan's installment history |
| Grace period for the funding method | The arrangement type's product figures |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A monthly plan on automatic debit has schedule anchor installment 4 due 10 January and a suspended date of 25 March; its type's automatic-debit grace reads 7 days in this illustration.

- Whole calendar months from 10 January to 25 March: 2. The examined installment is 4 plus 2, installment 6, due 10 March.
- Installment 6 was presented for collection. Grace start: 10 March. Elapsed days to 25 March: 15.
- Pre-suspension grace: 7 plus 0 plus 0 is 7 days.
- 15 is more than 7: the missed entry goes to installment 6.

With a suspended date of 15 March instead, the examined installment is still 6 and the elapsed days are 5, not more than 7: the missed entry goes to installment 5. Had installment 6 never been presented for collection, the missed entry would go to installment 6 in either case.
